decision_rules.ge1_qualifying: phase B2 acquire/clean/SHA/preregistered OOD split/leakage audit -> phase C
decision_rules.raw_inaccessible: record real reason (paywall/Cloudflare/throttle/no accession); never guess from abstract; raw-unverified source cannot be PASS
decision_rules.strategic_option_requires_user: whether to authorize a relaxed R3 (fixed leader + N-terminal synonymous editing window) for the FUNCTIONAL benchmark only, keeping strict R3 for start-structure transport claims; do NOT unilaterally relax frozen R1-R7
decision_rules.zero_qualifying: phase B3 record missing dimensions + prospective DBTL/wet-lab design; wet-lab budget and timeline extension REQUIRE user approval; measurement protocol frozen before reading outcomes

eligibility_requirements.R1: independent study/host (not the Kudla training cohort)
eligibility_requirements.R2: full CDS per variant (not an N-terminal segment / reporter fusion only)
eligibility_requirements.R3: variant-specific native 5'UTR (>=4nt upstream of ATG), reconstructable UTR[-4:]+CDS[:38]; fixed vector/synthetic leader does NOT count
eligibility_requirements.R4: fixed-protein synonymous library (amino acids invariant; cross-protein natural non-synonymous pools and amino-acid-level design factors do NOT count)
eligibility_requirements.R5: protein identity + family map enabling protein/study OOD
eligibility_requirements.R6: fresh continuous outcome with sufficient dynamic range (coarse ordinal does NOT count)
eligibility_requirements.R7: sequence-cluster/protein/study isolation feasible + license/accession/raw SHA documentable
